project_type: Harbor debugging task (lattice flow pressure simulation)
build_system: None (stdlib only), Dockerfile for container runtime
test_framework: pytest via uv (14 tests in 4 tiers)
verification_instructions: 1. Run orchestrator.py to generate outputs. 2. Run pytest to verify 8 pass / 6 fail (buggy). 3. Run repair script, regenerate, verify 14 pass / 0 fail (repaired).
snapshot_or_generated_files: flow_state.jsonl and flow_report.json are generated at runtime, not checked in
setup_instructions: Python 3.11 available. No special setup needed.
environment_constraints: Must work within Docker container. runtime/ and environment/runtime/ must be byte-identical (both contain buggy code).
contribution_requirements: Buggy code must produce 8 pass / 6 fail. Repaired code must produce 14 pass / 0 fail. The task must be significantly harder for AI to solve.
key_patterns: Arrow-separated trace format. JunctionPressure class with apply_pump/apply_surge/apply_couple. Flow analysis uses vector comparison. Report includes MD5 digest.
directory_structure: lattice-flow-repair/ contains: runtime/ (buggy source), environment/runtime/ (byte-identical buggy source for Docker), solution/ (repair script), tests/ (pytest), instruction.md, task.toml, environment/Dockerfile
